messages.author: c11f523d3ac8bd83
messages.subject: Residual covariances fixed to zero in model output, but not cov.lv
parts:
I've been trying to run a latent curve model with structured residuals. This model requires a great many constraints to converge, and one of the ones I'm using is to constrain all latent residual variances to be uncorrelated with one another unless I specify an auto-regression. 

However, when I run model syntax to do this, such as (partial syntax) :

a1~~0*a2 +0*a3 +0*a4 +0*a5 +0*a6 +0*a7 +0*a8 +0*s3 +0*s4 +0*s5 +0*s6 +0*s7 +0*s8


in the output, all of these residual covariances are estimated at zero, as expected:
For example:
a1 ~~                                                                 
   .a2                0.000                               0.000    0.000
   .a3                0.000                               0.000    0.000
   .a4                0.000                               0.000    0.000
   .a5                0.000                               0.000    0.000
   .a6                0.000                               0.000    0.000
   .a7                0.000                               0.000    0.000
   .a8                0.000                               0.000    0.000
   .s3                0.000                               0.000    0.000
   .s4                0.000                               0.000    0.000
   .s5                0.000                               0.000    0.000
   .s6                0.000                               0.000    0.000
   .s7                0.000                               0.000    0.000
   .s8                0.000                               0.000    0.000

However, when I examine the latent covariance/correlation matrices, they do NOT appear to be fixed to zero. I'm not sure what to make of that.
Partial output from cov.lv,
cov.matrix.ar[,"a1"]
    ia            sa        stress            a1            a2            a3            a4            a5            a6 
 0.0000000000  0.0000000000  0.0000000000  8.8698642987  2.1166652759  0.5589197343  0.1453130539  0.0378666239  0.0098641654 
           a7            a8            s1            s2            s3            s4            s5            s6            s7 
 0.0025697219  0.0006694353 19.6639300944 11.7802708798  2.8111918595  0.7423141604  0.1929936108  0.0502915345  0.0131008250 
           s8 
 0.0034129067 

As you can see, many of the correlations among the latent residuals (these are of a1 with all latent factors) seem to be freely estimated, which doesn't match the model output.

Am I missing something, or mis-interpreting one of these pieces of output?

Thanks,
Kevin King

messages.subject: Re: Residual covariances fixed to zero in model output, but not cov.lv
parts: The last output addresse total or zero-order covariance between variables. The constraints and the earlier output address only residual covariance (assuming that these variables are dependent on something else). If two variables have a common predictor, they will covary, even if their residual covariance is 0.
